主要内容: Tucson Electric Power Company (TEP) entered into a settlement agreement with Third-Party Owners on February 29, 2016, to resolve disputes and litigation related to Springerville Unit 1. Under the agreement, TEP will purchase the Third-Party Owners’ 50.5% undivided interest in Springerville Unit 1 for $85 million, while the Third-Party Owners will pay TEP $12.5 million for operating costs incurred on their behalf. The purchase is subject to Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approval and other customary closing conditions. TEP expects the transaction to close in the second quarter of 2016. The agreement also includes the release of all outstanding disputes and pending litigation between TEP and the Third-Party Owners. The settlement aims to finalize negotiations and resolve ongoing legal proceedings related to the Springerville Unit 1 project.
